series_start_reason: J&J's own schedules for 2022Q4 through 2023Q4 do not print Tecvayli on its own line (absent from those documents, measured). The 2024Q1 schedule's Supplemental Sales Information table restates 2023 quarterly (63, 94, 112, 126) but prints 2022 only as a full year (15; US 12, Intl 3), so no 2022Q4 quarterly figure is citable; the series starts at 2023Q1.
moa: BCMA x CD3 bispecific T-cell engager

search_log: Downloaded J&J's quarterly sales schedule PDFs 2021Q1-2026Q2 from the URLs of the existing J&J manifest (investor-site q4cdn); parsed every page with pdfplumber and searched case-insensitively for CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI, TALVEY, RYBREVANT, and the generic names (cache/jnj_rows.json).

Listed J&J 10-Q and 10-K filings 2021-2026 via data.sec.gov submissions (form 10-Q and 10-K only, no 8-K scan) and searched the primary documents for the four brand names: they appear only in prose or litigation text, only in narrative sentences (the only lines with a brand name and a number were prose).

Supplemental Sales Information schedules (Schedule 2 / 'Supplemental Sales Information' page) in the 2024Q1 and 2025Q1 schedules restate product lines quarterly; the 2024Q1 one carries Tecvayli, the 2025Q1 one carries Rybrevant/Lazcluze and Talvey.

FY2022 Tecvayli = 15 is printed in the 2024Q1 schedule's Supplemental table but the text layer splits it ('1 5'); not used. FDA approved Tecvayli in Q4 2022 (label: Initial U.S. Approval 2022), so the 2022 full year is plausibly all fourth quarter, but that is inference and was not recorded as a quarter.

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: J&J 10-K FY2022, 10-Q 2022Q3 and 2023Q1 contain no Tecvayli sales commentary (grepped TECVAYLI/teclistamab); the 2023Q2 10-Q says 'sales from the launch of TECVAYLI ... contributed to the growth'.; J&J 2022Q3 release lists EC authorisation (Aug 2022); FDA approval 2022-10-25; FY2022 sales 15 (U.S. 12, Int'l 3) from the 2024Q1 supplemental, so international sales occurred in 2022 but no document dates the first sale to Q3 or Q4 2022.; Janssen/jnj.com press releases found state approvals only, not a launch or first-sale date. launch_quarter null.
